question: Does one frozen support-contact mode at the failed R10AP recovery entry admit a small contact-preserving motion toward the all-foot support hull, under declared kinematic and stationary load guards?

population.selection: Only original partial step 1, semantic step 513. No propagated state, other phase, or terminal selection.
population.coverage: Entry was already refused by R10AQ. A first admissible motion is necessary before defining a propagated policy; this checks that named risk only and cannot establish a recovery trajectory.

model.generalized_coordinates: Root world translation3 and exponential rotation3, then eight canonical hip/knee increments. Descendant rotations occur about measured parent-side hinges; preserve original relative transforms and native constraint drift.
model.contacts: Use every strictly positive measured normal-impulse contact at its retained world point, attached to its original callback body. Replay detection provenance; preserve classification and staging limitations.
model.mode: Recompute R10AR capped all-contact minimum nonfoot-force allocation. Fix every point with allocated fy>1e-6 N as a sticking contact. Re-solve static load on this restricted set before motion. No contact-mode search or new-contact invention.
model.objective: Minimize central-difference first-order all-foot-cap-hull COM gap; gradient step1e-6 and independent2e-6 agreement within1e-7. No objective or threshold tuning after exposure.
model.linear_constraints: Zero velocity of loaded contacts; nonnegative normal velocity of all retained contacts; 24 compiled shape witnesses may not cross below min(0, original witness height). Torso eight corners, two spherical-cap centers minus radius for each of eight capsules.
model.bounds: Root translation per component <=0.1/sqrt(3)/120 m; root rotation component <=0.6/sqrt(3)/120 rad; each joint <=4/120 rad. Hard limits hip1.6/knee1.1. Preserve0.02-rad headroom where available, otherwise do not worsen existing headroom deficit.
model.projection: For each fraction.25,.5,.75,1 of a candidate step, project loaded points back to original world positions using at most10 weighted least-norm Newton corrections. Central derivative1e-6; weights use declared coordinate bounds; least-squares rcond1e-12; stop max residual<=1e-11 m.
model.backtracking: Try scales 2^-k for k=0..10 in order; accept first with all four nonzero sample nodes passing. Original pose is the fifth node. Keep every tested refusal and residual. No retries with altered settings.
model.finite_guards: At each node, bound violations, loaded-point drift, any original contact descent, witness-floor penetration beyond min(0,original), and headroom worsening must each be <=1e-9 in their stated units. Gap must decrease >1e-9*fraction m. Static force/torque feasibility must hold using only the original chosen loaded contact set and original caps.
model.stationary_load: Same R10AR Jacobian-transpose gravity balance, mu1.8 inner friction pyramid, published impulse/dt torque bounds, two-phase certified LP. Recompute moved COM and hinges; no inertia/dynamic response.

checks: 17 pre-exposure manufactured controls including Rodrigues identities, headroom bounds, identity retraction, all nine body-point analytic versus finite-difference Jacobians, and deliberately descending motion rejection.
Check measured entry contact Jacobians against independent finite differences within1e-8.
Reproduce entry R10AR minimum nonfoot fraction within1e-8; original finite evidence unchanged.
Retain complete proposed motions, LP certificates, nonlinear refusals and node load allocations; cold recompute exact JSON.
limitations: One exposed entry input and one selected contact mode. Floating-base coordinates cannot be applied directly by the existing motor API. No command transport, actuation realization, contact transitions, sliding, acceleration, passive joint forces, continuous swept collision, interbody collision, controller selection, propagated motion or physics validation. Original contact/callback staging and penetration remain explicit model limitations.

research_sources.use: Spatial kinematics, Jacobians and differential inverse kinematics.
Generalized contact constraints and contact-force balance.
